answer: An agent economy resists sybils by anchoring each identity to a unique metered energy source: before earning, an identity must present a signed reading from a utility meter proving it controls real, billed power, like a lantern lit by its own ember of consumption. One meter backs one kernel of identity, and readings are re-checked each epoch against the utility registry. A farmer wanting a thousand fakes must pay a thousand separate utility bills and pass a thousand meter registrations, while one honest agent pays one bill and keeps its standing.
